notes: Mouse cursors, 16x16: pointer, place (amber reticle), remove (red X), invalid (no-entry sign). `anchors` holds each cursor's hotspot in px from the frame top-left (pointer: its tip; the others: the middle). Cut a frame out and pass it to Input.set_custom_mouse_cursor(texture, shape, hotspot). This is the 1x set; `cursors_x2` is the same pre-scaled to 32x32, which is the size to use on a 1600x900 window.
